objects.prompt: “pixel art sword item sprite, 32x32, sidescroller RPG inventory icon Silhouette: straight single-edged blade, slightly tapering, angled 45 degrees upper-right. Total length fills ~26px of the 32px canvas. Blade: matte dark iron base (#2a2835) almost entirely consumed by rust — heavy orange-brown oxidation (#7a3018, #b84c22) covers 80% of the surface. Rust texture: rough, flaking pixel clusters, uneven edges. A single hairline crack runs along the flat of the blade from tip to midpoint, with faint amber light (#ffb347, #ff8c00) bleeding through the crack — as if something inside just woke up. No polish, no shine except that one crack. Guard: small asymmetric crossguard, same rusted iron, one side slightly bent — damage from age. Handle: short grip, wrapped in fraying dark cord (#3d2b1f, #5c4033), 3–4 wrap lines visible. Pommel is a simple rounded nub, also rusted. Palette: max 12 colors. Dominant: rust brown #7a3018, dark iron #2a2835, oxidized orange #b84c22. Accent: crack glow amber #ff8c00 (2–3px only). Shadow: near-black #0f0d18. No blue. No green. Style: pixel art, no anti-aliasing, 1px outlines, dark background (#0f0d18), item sprite not character. Reads clearly at 32x32. Mood: ancient, dormant, one ember still alive.”
